name: nucleation_item_float_water
description: Buoyancy, isolated: an authored item at the bottom of a two-deep walled column. setUnderwaterMovement's 5e-4 nudge accumulates against the 0.99 horizontal drag until the item bobs at the surface — 120 ticks of pure fluid physics, no RNG anywhere.
